accessibility:
- Trigger uses `role="combobox"` with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls`.
- Popover panel has `role="dialog"` with an accessible name.
- Each spinner column has `role="spinbutton"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`, and `aria-valuetext`.
- AM/PM toggle exposes `aria-pressed`.
- Honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.
summary: The `TimeInput` component is a form input that opens a popover spinner for time-of-day selection.

parts.summary: The `TimeInput` component is a form input that opens a popover spinner for time-of-day selection.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Not wired in `inline` mode (no visible input to label) and dropped inside an outer `Field`.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Render the field with horizontal layout.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Icon props for the left icon.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Icon props for the right icon.

props.name: iconRightName
props.description: Shortcut for the right icon name.

props.name: iconLeftSize
props.description: Shortcut for left icon size.

props.name: iconRightSize
props.description: Shortcut for right icon size.

props.name: hasIconsLeft
props.description: Force the left icon container.

props.name: hasIconsRight
props.description: Force the right icon container.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Show a loading indicator on the control.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Expand the control to fill its container.

props.name: controlSize
props.description: Size of the wrapping Control.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation text below the input.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Color modifier for the help message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Control wrapper.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected time (date portion is preserved).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired when the value changes.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when the popover opens.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the popover closes.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable time.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable time.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Make the input read-only.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the input.

props.name: format
props.description: Token format string or `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options.

props.name: parse
props.description: Custom parser.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale tag for Intl formatting.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render the spinner inline (no popover).

props.name: mobileNative
props.description: Use `<input type="time">` on coarse-pointer + small-viewport devices.

props.name: editable
props.description: Allow segmented keyboard typing in the input (type the time directly, auto-advancing across segments). `false` makes the field picker-only.

props.name: popover
props.description: Whether the spinner popover exists. `false` makes the field input-only (segmented typing, no popover).

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open the popover when the input is focused.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the popover after a time is selected (off by default).

props.name: position
props.description: Popover anchor position relative to the input.

props.name: appendToBody
props.description: Render the popover into `document.body` via portal.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Render the input with rounded corners.

props.name: hourFormat
props.description: Hour format. `'12'` shows an AM/PM toggle.

props.name: enableSeconds
props.description: Show a seconds column. Note: iOS Safari's native time picker UI does not include a seconds wheel; pass `mobileNative={false}` if you need one on iOS.

props.name: incrementHours
props.description: Hour step for the spinner.

props.name: incrementMinutes
props.description: Minute step. Combine with `min`/`max` for slot-style pickers.

props.name: incrementSeconds
props.description: Second step. Default `1`.

props.name: unselectableTimes
props.description: Predicate returning `true` for times that should be skipped. Blocked times are also rejected during manual typing.

props.name: iconLeftName
props.description: Decorative left icon glyph for the wrapping `Control` (shown by default). Set `''` to hide.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Show a clickable launcher button on the right that toggles the popover. Default `true`.

props.name: triggerIconName
props.description: Glyph for the right launcher button.

props.name: labels
props.description: Optional translatable string overrides.

props.name: audioTick
props.description: Play a short audible click on each wheel-item crossing. Substitute for haptic feedback on iOS Safari (which has no web haptic API as of May 2026); on Android, `navigator.vibrate(5)` fires automatically regardless.

props.name: haptics
props.description: Auto-route platform-appropriate feedback: vibrate on Android (already happening), audio thunk on iOS (where vibrate is unavailable). One switch instead of platform-sniffing on the consumer side. `audioTick={true}` always wins.

extraProps.name: form
extraProps.description: Form id the input belongs to.

extraProps.name: className
extraProps.description: Additional CSS classes for the input.
